Privacy Policy – Free Career Notice

Date: 01/03/2026

At Free Career Notice, accessible from

https://freecareernotice.needfulcalculator.com/,

one of our main priorities is the privacy of our visitors.

This Privacy Policy document explains what types of information are collected and recorded by Free Career Notice and how we use it.

Information We Collect

We may collect personal information such as:

• Name

• Email address

• Any information you provide when contacting us

We only collect information when visitors voluntarily submit it.

Log Files

Free Career Notice follows a standard procedure of using log files. These files log visitors when they visit websites. The information collected may include:

• Internet Protocol (IP) address

• Browser type

• Internet Service Provider (ISP)

• Date and time stamp

• Referring/exit pages

This information is used to analyze trends and improve our website experience.

Cookies

Like many websites, Free Career Notice uses cookies to store information about visitors’ preferences and the pages they access on the website. This helps us improve user experience.

Google Advertising Cookies

Some advertisements on our site may be served by advertising partners such as Google. These partners may use cookies such as the DART cookie to serve ads based on visitors’ interests and browsing behavior.

Users may choose to decline cookies through their browser settings.

Third-Party Privacy Policies

Free Career Notice’s Privacy Policy does not apply to other websites or advertisers. We advise users to consult the respective Privacy Policies of third-party websites for more information.

Children’s Information

Protecting children while using the internet is important to us. Free Career Notice does not knowingly collect any personal identifiable information from children under the age of 13.

Consent

By using our website, you hereby consent to our Privacy Policy and agree to its terms.
